description: Local Obsidian vault connector (notes, backlinks, daily notes). No network. Vault paths come from [[filesystem.roots]] and are merged into permissions.filesystem.read at spawn time by the Gateway, which may also add the vaults to permissions.filesystem.write at spawn (only while the owner has approved obsidian_append_to_daily_note for the model). obsidian_append_to_daily_note requires HITL; obsidian_daily_note_get is a read.
author: Nimbus
